newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria frx mkt listless amid opposition protests.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria frx mkt listless amid opposition protests.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev closed early at 660-665 per dollar in very low volume, unchanged on the opening in a listless interbank market which was preoccupied with opposition protests at the parliament building, traders said.

Dealers said trade thinned down to a trickle in the early afternoon as traders closely followed day-long protests against the ruling Socialists by opposition supporters who are demanding early parliamentary elections.
"We are really worried about what is going on. Interbank trade has been virtually nil since early afternoon," a commercial bank dealer said.

"I expect the lev to come under strong pressure on Monday due to uncertainty amid this strong social and political unrest," another dealer said, adding that many traders would probably be reluctant to sell dollars.

Hundreds of anti-government protesters broke through a riot police cordon outside Bulgaria's parliament in a bid to storm the assembly during a protest to demand early parliamentary elections, witnesses said.
But the protesters pulled back when opposition leaders urged them to withdraw.
Later dozens of protesters broke into the building housing the parliament. Police tried to block their way with tables inside the building, witnesses said.

The opposition supporters surrounded the parliament in a human chain at midday after the ruling Bulgarian Socialist Party refused to vote on a "salvation declaration" which demanded an early national poll. -- Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
